column3: dev:smoke rides the bundle script, not a new CI job; it installs web deps when web/node_modules is missing and skips when .dev.vars exists
column4: the device token lacks the workflow scope, so a .github/workflows change cannot be pushed, and Bosun chose not to wait on it; CI does not run scripts/gate.ts, so the hook goes in a package script the CI gate job already runs, and bundle runs once per CI run (test runs twice)
column5: gate bundle step and CI gate job both run dev:smoke (~12 s)
